cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm sending you off with soup and warm bread. Before your train, taste the soup; let's see what you learned about seasoning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It needs salt. There, I learned something. Coat, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nearly. A cook checks the correction too. One more taste after I salt it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, it's right now. I've got ten minutes to reach the station.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your bread needs wrapping first. Fold this cloth with me; I clearly left transport out of your cookery lessons.

reason: Establish the bread gift in A1 before its packing becomes the last delay, and make A5 a concrete joint task caused by imminent departure rather than a newly invented loaf.
